adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the job builds `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (line ~35). This will raise `NoMethodError` if `i.content` is `nil` (common for feeds/items that don’t populate a `content` accessor), because it unconditionally calls `scrub` on it. The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single such item would crash the hourly run and prevent subsequent items from being imported until the next successful run. The diff shows no fallback to other fields (e.g., `content_encoded`) or nil-guarding, so the crash risk is real.
